questions.question: What is a landmark? Give two qualities of a good landmark.
questions.expected_answer: A landmark is a feature that is easy to see and remember and helps people find their way. A good landmark stands out because it is big or unusual, it stays in the same place, and many people know it.

questions.question: Give two examples of natural landmarks and two examples of human-made landmarks.
questions.expected_answer: Natural landmarks: a river, a mountain, a big tree, a waterfall. Human-made landmarks: a bridge, a water tower, a stadium, a church or a statue.

questions.question: Explain the steps to draw a short journey, such as the way to school.
questions.expected_answer: Draw the start, such as home, and the end, such as school, and label them. Draw a path between them. Draw the landmarks along the path in the order you pass them and label them. Add arrows to show the direction.
